It runs on Modal. A scheduled function pulls new posts every hour, so there's no server to keep running. Calling .map() checks the claims in parallel across containers. A Modal Dict stores the results, a web endpoint serves the page at a public modal.run URL, and a Modal Secret holds the xAI key. Between runs it scales to zero, and you pay by the second, instead of leaving a laptop script or a server on all day.
